著者関連情報

The Yamate Tunnel is a long urban tunnel in the Central Circular Route of the Metropolitan Expressway. This tunnel has heavy traffic volume and multiple junctions within the tunnel. Ventilation of long Urban tunnel requires not only normal ventilation for visibility and CO, but also advanced ventilation control during a fire. Not only that, it is also necessary to deal with issues that are not normally expected, such as measures against heat and vehicle condensation. In this paper, we report the optimal operation method of the tunnel ventilation equipment for the peculiar problems to these long urban tunnels.
